author: AlexCR
quote:
The game doesn't even feel like a "GTA" anymore. It strayed too far into being a game about simping for Lucia, filled with casual odd jobs and domestic filler tasks. As for performance, the graphics simply don't justify sacrificing the fluidity needed to actually enjoy the game. Being capped at 30 FPS in 2026 was already a "umm, okay?" moment, but seeing it drop below 30 FPS even on the PS5 Pro is just disappointing—there was no proper balance between performance and visual detail.
The core mechanics are fine, and I can even admit that the world's spontaneity is fun to play, but the main story completely kills that momentum. On top of that, there are already plenty of visual bugs, and several mechanics could have been improved compared to GTA V if they were really aiming for more realism. In my opinion, they could have just stuck with the graphical level they achieved in Red Dead Redemption 2. All in all, it's a real letdown after 13 years of waiting—and to top it all off, the physical edition is just a digital download shoved inside a plastic case.
